text:
A metal block is left overnight in a cool, shady room. In the morning, the metal block is moved
into warm surroundings.
Which statement about the metal block is correct in the morning?
A
The internal energy of the metal block increases.
B
The temperature of the metal block decreases.
C
Convection transfers energy throughout the metal block.
D
The metal contracts slightly.

options.label: A
options.text: The internal energy of the metal block increases.

options.label: B
options.text: The temperature of the metal block decreases.

options.label: C
options.text: Convection transfers energy throughout the metal block.
